blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Garden Grove
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: The Strawberry Festival closes streets around Village Green and on-site parking is functionally nonexistent, so a coach lets the group arrive once and stay through the evening.
Christ Cathedral receptions spread across a 34-acre campus whose own parking does not cover a large wedding, so staging coaches on Chapman Avenue is standard practice.
The Euclid Street and Chapman Avenue restaurant corridors have single-digit lot counts and fill at prime dinner hours.
Knott's Berry Farm and the Anaheim Packing District are only a few miles away, making multi-stop evening routes easy.

blocks.text: We also quote Garden Grove to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Garden Grove Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
